ch0201_00_jindai/0101_0701_01_10:
Hahahah! [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Are you ready to head out on an adventure?
ch0201_00_jindai/7101_0701_01_10:
Young adventurer! Are you enjoying your
days on Pasio?
ch0201_00_jindai/7101_0701_02_10:
Give your utmost! If you bring your courage,
you can overcome any adversity!
ch0201_00_jindai/7105_0701_01_10:
[Name:PlayerNickname ]! You are exactly
as I was in my own youth!
ch0201_00_jindai/7105_0701_02_10:
I can tell from your face that your love of
adventure comes deep from within your
heart!
ch0201_00_jindai/7105_0701_03_10:
And my courage sensor shows me you’ve
got guts!
ch0201_00_jindai/1701_0701_02_10:
I have something I’d like to bestow on you!
Please take this!
ch0201_00_jindai/1701_0702_01_10:
Combined with your courage, this useful tool
should bring you tremendous strength!
ch0201_00_jindai/2501_0701_01_10:
I once journeyed all over the world, meeting
and befriending many rare Pokémon!
ch0201_00_jindai/2501_0701_02_10:
Looking back, those life-or-death adventures
make wonderful memories!
ch0201_00_jindai/2501_0702_01_10: Would you like to go on grand adventures?
ch0201_00_jindai/2501_0702_02_10:
If so, dreams alone won’t get you there.
You must prepare—and embark with a solid
foundation!
ch0201_00_jindai/2501_0702_03_10:
True courage is different from recklessness!
Making it back home safe is part of the
adventure, too!
ch0201_00_jindai/3001_0701_01_10:
Good morning, young explorer! The morning
sun is brilliant today as always, don’t you
think?!
ch0201_00_jindai/3003_0701_01_10:
I’m perfectly prepared to set out on an
adventure at any time! My courage is off
the meter!
ch0201_00_jindai/3005_0701_01_10:
What, you didn’t get enough adventure? If
that’s the case, you should continue the
adventure in your dreams!
